description: Import limits, import errors -> message keys, the pure ImportDecision table, library entry states and the calibration lifecycle tables (plans/WP4-calibration-lifecycle-shared_contract.md s2, s3, s8, s9). Both apps load the constants from here in tests. Generated by scripts/gen_calibration_fixtures.py, never hand edited.

rules.prechecks: s9.2 in order: library not Loaded -> locked; entries >= maxLibraryEntries -> libraryFull {limit}; size > pdfMaxBytes / mbtilesMaxBytes -> tooLarge {limit in bytes}; free < size + freeSpaceMarginBytes -> noSpace {size = size + margin, in bytes}. Byte args are formatted by the platform (ByteCountFormatter / Formatter.formatShortFileSize)
rules.inspection: s9.5 in order: can't open -> invalidPdf; encrypted and the empty password doesn't open it -> password; pages > maxPages -> tooManyPages {limit}; any page's MediaBox or CropBox (CropBox defaults to MediaBox) with a side outside [pageSideMinPt, pageSideMaxPt] -> pageSize. Watchdog past parseTimeoutMs, and on Android OutOfMemoryError / StackOverflowError at the inspector boundary, -> tooComplex
rules.decision: s9.4 + s9.6, see decisions[]. pages[] lists the scanned pages only (georefScanPages); page in an outcome is 0-based, the toast args are 1-based
rules.reasonText: map_import_georef_rejected {reason} gets a georefRejectReasons code; the contract has no per-reason copy yet
rules.entryStates: s8.2 derived state: unavailable (file missing or size/mtime mismatch) overrides; mbtiles -> offlineTiles or derived; manual -> calibrated; embedded -> geoPDF; embeddedIssue -> rejected; else needsCalibration. effective georef = manual ?? embedded. Subtitle: unavailable, else a draft's map_state_draft, else the state's. rowTap: activate when it can be the durable active selection, calibrate for the other PDFs, nothing when unavailable (the start precondition needs the file). Menu ids are the map_action_* keys plus generateOfflineTiles (WP2) for entries with an effective georef; unavailable rows only offer delete

prechecks.note: locked wins over every other failure
check order: locked, full, size, space

inspections.note: owner-password only: opens with the empty password
any page, either box: page 2's boxes are both outside
the MediaBox counts even when the CropBox is fine

decisions.note: a usable georef anywhere wins over a broken one on page 1
added as rejected, not active, alert with Calibrate now / Later
several pages but only page 1 declares one: same as single page
the first page isn't the ONLY declaring one
no badges; cancel deletes the copy
only pages 1-50 are scanned for a georef, the rest count as none
contentKey already in the library: the copy is deleted, the existing entry activated
existing entry has no georef: calibration starts on it

E9: the existing entry's file is missing or changed. The new copy has the entry's content key, so it is kept: one write re-links the entry to it (fileName, byteCount, fileModifiedAtMs), the old file goes, calibration and bake record stay, then it's activated

entryStates.note: manual wins, 'use the PDF's own georeferencing' is offered, multi-page so 'choose page' too
a draft's subtitle replaces the state one
unavailable even with a draft; only Delete is offered
S2 rebuild adopted a PDF that failed inspection: pageCount 0, unavailable even though the file is fine, Delete only
tiles baked from a PDF entry

draftActive.note: beginAdd writes the draft with pending, active = true
pending cleared, still in the session
C1: state equals the start seed so leave ends at once, but a draft exists: rewrite it active = false or E3 resumes it every launch
C1: suspend rewrites an existing draft active = false even when not dirty
C6 (iOS): Resume writes active = true straight away, before any mutation
draft deleted, the seed is used; the next mutation writes a new active draft
C6: E3 rewrites active = true (and reopens draft.pending)
C5: the datum picked on the s2.3 step 12 sheet at 0 points is part of the start seed: not dirty, no draft, no leave dialog
any later datum change is an undoable mutation

autoResume.note: frames the sheet like an E1/E2 start (OD-F1), then calibration_off_sheet still wins the status line
C6 (Android): the entry card reopens on draft.pending
C6 (iOS): no calibration_resumed toast at 0 points
kept for the resume prompt only
M10/C2: any pending crash suspect skips it; the draft stays active for the next launch
C8: the guard was armed with the previewed (non-durable) entry's token, so that entry is the suspect
F3: runs after the first Loaded restore (unlock or Retry), same rules then
start precondition: file present; the draft stays
reconcile prunes the draft once its contentKey isn't in the library

suspectStart.event: startCalibration (E1/E2) on the pending crash suspect
suspectStart.expect: guard resolved as Open Anyway first, then calibration starts and publishes
suspectStart.note: C2/M10: picking the suspect in Layers counts as Open Anyway too

choosePage.note: E14: the picker opened from Layers uses map_choose_page_message; map_import_choose_page_message ('none has usable georeferencing') is for the import picker only. The write is the s8.2 change page transition (manual, bake and draft go)

rows.note: E1: picking the current page does nothing
E1: a hand calibration is only wiped after the confirm
E4 (Android): a page with a valid georef is activated, framed
the active entry loses its georef: the same write sets active = online(preferredOnlineStyle)

importPipeline.errors: every s9.2/s9.5/M7 failure is an alert with OK (OD-F5); cancelled and duplicate stay toasts
importPipeline.pageUsedToast: map_import_page_used after the write, never before the probe (E7)

triggers: import: single-page PDF with no usable georef
import: page picked in the page picker
Layers row tap on needsCalibration or rejected
row menu map_action_calibrate on any PDF entry, GeoPDFs included
launch: a draft with active == true whose entry exists, after the library restore

seed.datumSheet: shown first unless the PDF has an embedded datum (preselected)

buttons.calibration_start_over: delete the draft, use the seed

leave.draft: if one exists, rewrite it active = false (C1)

afterLeave.preview: restore the previous durable source, published without reframing

suspend.when: the active map source changes to a different entry mid-session
suspend.effect: end the session, keep the draft with active = false (rewritten even when not dirty, C1)
suspend.notASuspend: an unlock / Retry restore that republishes the same durable selection while a calibration display is up (C3): no republish, the session goes on

commit.check: entryId, contentKey and pageIndex all match the target, else nothing is written
commit.write: one library write: entry.pdf.manual = {datumId, points, georef, n, rmsM, grade, savedAtMs} and active = entry
success: end the session, restore heading-up and chrome

mutations.numbering: number = nextNumber++, never renumbered, delete leaves a gap

libraryWrites.write: add entry, plus active if it has a georef or is MBTiles
pageIndex, embedded, embeddedIssue; manual = nil; draft deleted
remove the entry and its derived entries; active = online(preferredOnlineStyle) if any of them was active

rows.note: S1/S2: sealed recovery provenance survives cold launch; unknown map files, bakes and drafts are preserved
D8: legacy stores still there after a Loaded restore are cleared (after the library is durable)
F3: issue with Retry; Retry and mission-data unlock re-run migration + restore
S1: the second load after a quarantine is NOT empty
S1: a library this device wrote before and is gone now is corrupt, never empty
genuinely empty, nothing to migrate: authoritative (the keep set is empty and there's nothing to delete)
write the library, then clear legacy, then restore as Loaded
S1: a quarantined legacy selector blocks; it never reads as 'no legacy left'
S3: legacy PDF present but its session/prefs/hash/link/document can't be read or converted: fail closed, nothing written, cleared or deleted
S4: authenticated legacy read that names no existing file: write an empty library, clear legacy

steps: re-adopt every opaque map file no in-flight import owns (not tacmap-bake-*)
contentKey re-hashed, displayName map_recovered_name {n} in mtime order
PDF: s9.5 inspection (marker + watchdog) + s9.6 first valid page, no picker; failed inspection -> pageCount 0 (unavailable, Delete only)
MBTiles: validated, failed -> still adopted, unavailable
active = online(default style); one library write
write fails -> nothing changes, still corrupt
after the write the library is Loaded with recoveryPreservesOrphans=true: no reconcile/sweep/prune
corrupt.deletes: no imported map file, bake or draft; the sealed flag disables cleanup on later restores and transitions too

locked.note: re-run migration + restore, same as mission-data unlock

libraryLoad.rule: reconcile, the bake sweep and the draft prune only ever run on a state read back as loaded (or a genuine first-launch empty), or the result of a library write made from one. Never from a state built in memory to stand in for a locked, corrupt or blocked one. Rebuilt states persist recoveryPreservesOrphans=true and never authorize cleanup; explicit deletion still removes known owned files

sizeDisplay.rule: OD-F6: import byte args (too_large {limit}, no_space {size}) and the Layers footer {size} use the pdf_tile_render.json bakeFormat size rule. The footer counts every entry's file plus its bake file (OD-F14)
